description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ParserModifySubPanel', which extends 'ParserModifyListView' to modify subpanel definitions within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder environment. It handles loading, retrieving, and saving subpanel layout configurations, including managing available and default fields, and processing save requests for subpanel customizations.

classes.name: ParserModifySubPanel
classes.description: Class for modifying and saving subpanel layouts in SuiteCRM, extending list view parsing functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the parser with module and subpanel names, loads relevant definition objects, and retrieves current layout definitions.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns the list of default fields to display in the subpanel.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Returns the list of available fields that can be added to the subpanel, including fields from the parent module not currently included.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a specific field by name from list, original, or panel field definitions.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the updated subpanel layout definitions based on user modifications, including handling widths and field properties.
